title: Bounded release calculus for published engineering relations: reproducibility package
description: Software and derived artefacts for a bounded-release calculus over published engineering relations. A typed contract binds a relation to its declared domain, displayed precision, a finite candidate class and provenance; a fixed reducer returns exactly one computational permission: REJECT_NONEXECUTABLE, RETAIN_BOUNDED_CLAIM or ALLOW_BOUNDED_QUERY. Operational design use lies outside the computational closure and is never emitted. Three heterogeneous contracts exercise the same interface: a lipped-angle relation whose printed expression is rejected while one of 48 printed-magnitude assignments is interval-feasible and whose four groupwise scale intervals are non-empty but share no common value; a lipped-channel relation retained while its mode selector and corner idealisation remain open; and a 445-cell geotechnical table in which two of nine attributed correlations reject on positivity and seven retain bounded claims under the displayed half-unit. Native third-party model files and the source report PDF are not redistributed; every source DOI, URL, hash and redistribution decision is recorded in DATASETS_AND_LINKS.csv. The engineering review in evidence/ is an author self-review, not an independent review.
